entries.name: JSBSim C++ shared library
entries.scope: C++ library compiled by upstream src CMake; excludes aircraft/engine/system XML, tests, bindings and Unreal plugin
entries.decision: Conditional redistribution through replaceable DLL plus corresponding source and retained component notices; explicit file grants govern compiled scope.

source.applicability: C++ library; SimGear Library-GPL-2.0-or-later grants permit later 2.1 choice

library_policy.source_delivery: Distribute a reproducible library-only corresponding-source bundle with the complete compiled dependency closure, upstream build inputs needed for the DLL, original notices and build/replacement instructions. Exclude aircraft/engine/system XML, tests and unrelated bindings/plugins. Review its file inventory and separate SHA-256 before release; upstream acquisition ZIP is not cleared for redistribution.
library_policy.modification_policy: Initial policy permits unmodified upstream library only. Any patch requires reviewed source archive/digest and dated change notices before release.
